We’re excited to spotlight the CLARION Project as it launches its new LinkedIn page. Be sure to follow the new CLARION Project account for updates, resources, and stories focused on helping students thoughtfully engage with civic issues in today’s digital world.

CLARION, which stands for Civic Literacy and Reasoning in Online Networks, brings educators together to explore civic media literacy, inquiry, deliberation, and student action.

Earlier this semester, educators gathered for a Civic Action on Social Media professional development event to learn more about the project’s four mini-units and discuss ways to bring these topics into their classrooms. The session also created space for educators to consider how students can connect what they’re learning with issues that matter to their communities.

We’re proud to celebrate the educators contributing to this work and helping students become thoughtful, informed participants in civic life. Follow CLARION Project to stay connected with the project:
